title: France and Cambodia share their love for pétanque in Phnom Penh
summary: Phnom Penh is hosting the 20th Francophonie Summit this Sunday and Monday. French President Emmanuel Macron is attending as part of a 3-day state visit to Cambodia. France and Cambodia's history is deep rooted and complex, but the two countries have one thing in common: a love for pétanque. Story by Caitlin Brown.
